verdict.rationale: Skyfire's MCP server lets an agent autonomously discover sellers, mint kya/pay tokens, and 'orchestrate agent commerce workflows' without human intervention, which supports some autonomous agentic operation, but this is transaction-level agent tooling, not a facility for a user to configure persistent, scheduled, or trigger-based background automations. Missing for 10: any scheduling/trigger/cron mechanism, persistent background job management, or evidence of continuous unattended operation beyond per-call MCP tool invocations.
